rca of the issue: RCA (UI testing blocker): SpecFormModal uses custom KNSelect/radix-style dynamic dropdown where trigger has data-testid but option rows do not expose deterministic testids. During modal rendering updates, locator attachment/visibility changed between actions, causing flaky automation and preventing guaranteed family+axis selection in E2E. Mitigation: add stable testids for dropdown content + options and optionally freeze render state while modal open. Also reconcile read-only entity-scope messaging with create affordance to reduce ambiguity.
